name: Maharaj L M R
roleLine: Mechatronics engineer · ROS 2, control and simulation
identityLine: I build ROS 2 systems for robots that have to share space and keep working: a five-AGV fleet that clears its own deadlocks, a jib arm that loads a lathe chuck, and the kinematics underneath them.
bio: I am a third-year BE Mechatronics student at Chennai Institute of Technology. Most of my work is ROS 2 simulation and the maths under mobile robots and arms.

Two of the projects here started as hackathon robots: a warehouse AGV (2nd runner-up, Bonfiglioli x CIT 2026) and a CNC lathe loading arm (1st runner-up, DriveNext RANE 2026). I rebuilt both in simulation afterwards so the behaviour could be measured instead of described.
Every number on this site comes from a script or a recorded run in the matching repository. Where a dimension is estimated or a system has only ever run in simulation, the page says so.
From November 2026 I am a research intern on parallel robots at IIT Madras. I am looking for robotics, ROS 2 and autonomy engineering roles in Bengaluru, Chennai, Hyderabad or remote.
lookingFor: Robotics, ROS 2 and autonomy engineering roles — Bengaluru, Chennai, Hyderabad or remote.

experience.detail: Incoming research intern on a parallel robotics project.

Four-month research internship building robotic applications on a Hiwonder JetAcker kit with NVIDIA Jetson: ROS 1 and ROS 2, Gazebo, SLAM, computer vision, voice control and multimodal AI. Worked on autonomous navigation, sensor integration and robot software.
Studied Caterpillar 3412 locomotive diesel engines, traction and cooling systems, battery management, and mechanical to electrical power conversion for traction motors.
Two months on machining, mechanical assembly and fabrication of precision components, with quality inspection and CNC machining practice.
